name: ice storm
lore:
# Arcane Compendium: Ice Storm

To manifest the *Ice Storm* is to invite the brutal indifference of the high peaks into the lowlands. As the caster manipulates the Weave, it feels like grasping a handful of jagged, frozen diamonds; the mana crystallizes in the lungs, turning breath to silver mist.

Visually, the spell begins as a sudden, localized darkening of the sky. Within heartbeats, a violent vortex of translucent shards and hailstones the size of a fist descends. It is not a flurry, but a crushing weight—a symphony of shattering ice that pummels the earth and numbs the marrow.

Scholars attribute its discovery to Archmage Valerius during the Siege of the Cinder Wastes. Faced with a legion of pyromancers, Valerius did not merely seek water to quench their fire; he reached into the primordial "Deep Frost" of the astral void. He brought forth a localized winter so severe that it shattered the obsidian walls of the enemy fortress, turning their very heat into a lethal brittleness.

*Note to the traveler: Ensure your boots are well-cleated before the casting concludes.*
